terminalCreationFollowUp.sourceRevision: The commit containing this follow-up record; exact tested source hashes are below.
terminalCreationFollowUp.authorization: Lead authorizes minimal extension to packages/app/src/context/terminal.tsx plus its focused tests to expose terminal creation failure to cockpit.
terminalCreationFollowUp.behavior: new() fulfills a typed created/failed result for v1 and v2. Rejections retain legacy logging/focus cleanup; a response without a PTY ID also fails. The cockpit shows pending/disabled state, a localized Request failed alert with source diagnostics, and explicit Retry. Queued duplicate clicks are ignored and disposed/session-changed consumers cannot receive stale failure state.
